New Qwen3.5 reward model uses matching qwen3_5 template with non-thinking selection output; not a claim that old OpenWebRL checkpoints are Qwen3.5.

Serving context version v3-sol-graph-262k: all three actor checkpoints advertise native max_position_embeddings=262144. Restore this full capacity without context truncation or RoPE changes. The prior 131072 serving cap failed on WebShop step 75 and is retained as diagnostic only. Candidate output remains capped at 1024 tokens.

Prior ALFWorld prompt-grammar results are diagnostic only. The corrected command was replayed at the failed TextWorld state and completed the native task successfully.
